en_title: GTA 6 Caused Some Gamers to Hold Off on Buying New Games — Including Take-Two's Own NBA 2K27, Strauss Zelnick Says
cn_title: Strauss Zelnick称，《GTA6》让一些玩家暂缓购买新游戏，包括Take-Two自家的《NBA 2K27》
opus_summary: Take-Two表示，《NBA 2K27》销量达到400万份，低于该时期预期。Strauss Zelnick认为，竞争激烈的发行档期可能影响了游戏表现，《GTA6》即将推出也对消费者产生了影响，但他对《NBA 2K27》的表现感到满意。

paragraphs.en: The behemoth that is GTA 6 looms large over the video game industry, and it’s so big that it not only caused the September crush of releases, but caused some gamers to hold off on buying new games.
paragraphs.cn: 庞然大物《GTA6》笼罩着电子游戏行业，它的影响力如此之大，不仅导致多款游戏扎堆在9月发售，还让一些玩家暂缓购买新游戏。

paragraphs.en: Reporting its latest financial results, Take-Two, parent company of GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games, said that its own NBA 2K27 had sold 4 million units, which was “below our forecast for the period.”
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》开发商Rockstar的母公司Take-Two在公布最新财务业绩时表示，自家的《NBA 2K27》已售出400万份，「低于我们对该时期的预期」。

paragraphs.en: Take-Two, which owns both 2K and NBA developer Visual Concepts, said that the NBA 2K27 launch window was “unusually busy, with numerous entertainment experiences competing for players’ attention.” In an accompanying interview with IGN , Zelnick expanded on the point, adding that he felt that GTA 6 had an impact also.
paragraphs.cn: 同时拥有2K和《NBA》开发商Visual Concepts的Take-Two表示，《NBA 2K27》的发售时段「异常繁忙，众多娱乐体验争夺玩家的注意力」。在同期接受IGN采访时，Zelnick进一步阐述了这一观点，并补充说，他认为《GTA6》也产生了影响。

paragraphs.en: “I think the key point is that while below our forecast, NBA 2K27 is our second best release of NBA 2K in history. It's an immensely successful title. It sold 4 million units. And in launching more content than ever before for the rest of the year, we have expectations that the title will do even better than it already has done,” Zelnick began.
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick首先表示：「我认为关键在于，尽管低于我们的预期，《NBA 2K27》仍是我们有史以来发售表现第二好的《NBA 2K》作品。这是一款极其成功的游戏，售出了400万份。随着我们在今年剩余时间里推出比以往更多的内容，我们预计这款游戏的表现会比现在更好。」

paragraphs.en: “I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far. It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我确实认为，这个时间点可能影响了迄今为止的表现。这段时期竞争激烈，我们也确实认为《GTA6》即将推出对消费者产生了影响。话虽如此，我们对《NBA 2K27》的表现感到非常高兴。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is credited with forcing developers and publishers to either bring their releases forward or move them back in an effort to avoid November. The likes of The Blood of Dawn Walker, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Marvel's Wolverine, Control Resonant and others all launched up against each other in September. NBA 2K27 was officially released globally on September 4, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 人们认为，《GTA6》迫使开发商和发行商将作品提前或推迟发售，以避开11月。《The Blood of Dawn Walker》《Onimusha: Way of the Sword》《漫威金刚狼》《控制：共振》等作品都在9月发售，相互竞争。《NBA 2K27》于2026年9月4日在全球正式发售。

paragraphs.en: Based on Zelnick's comments, GTA 6 won't just have affected NBA 2K27 sales, but caused some gamers to skip other games in favor of Rockstar's next, which comes out November 19. It is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, setting sales and revenue records, so Take-Two will of course be fine for some time to come. Other publishers and developers, though, might be left struggling.
paragraphs.cn: 根据Zelnick的言论，《GTA6》影响的可能不只是《NBA 2K27》的销量，还让一些玩家跳过其他游戏，转而选择Rockstar这款将于11月19日推出的新作。预计它将成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品发行，创下销量和收入纪录，因此Take-Two在未来一段时间内当然不会有问题。但其他发行商和开发商可能会陷入困境。

paragraphs.en: For now, though, during the quarter Take-Two saw revenue of $1.6 billion, which was slightly below its guidance range of $1.62-$1.67 billion. The company said fiscal 2027 will be "an historic year for Take-Two – driven by our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest quality entertainment experiences." It reiterated our Fiscal 2027 outlook for revenue of $8-$8.2 billion.
paragraphs.cn: 不过就目前而言，Take-Two本季度的收入为16亿美元，略低于其16.2亿至16.7亿美元的指引区间。该公司表示，2027财年将是「Take-Two具有历史意义的一年——这得益于我们对提供最高品质娱乐体验的坚定承诺」。该公司重申了2027财年收入将达到80亿至82亿美元的预期。
